note: Second sample, written differently from marks_calculator, to check that AutoPatch Core generalizes.

bugs.summary: eval() on console input runs arbitrary code.
Negative or >MAX_DISCOUNT percentages get a band instead of being rejected.
Sorts descending, so it returns the most expensive products.
Uses > minimum_stock, so exactly 5 items does not count as well stocked.
Mutable default cart shared between calls.
SQL built with an f-string from `name` (SQL injection).

not_bugs.summary: `q < minimum_stock` is correct: exactly the minimum needs no restock.
